ja.title: Sunvozertinibの用量と投与回数
ja.summary: 実測集計PKから用量―曝露関係を推定し、4096人の条件付き仮想患者でQDとBIDを比較。奏効・下痢の集団差と、親薬物PKのレジメン予測を区別する。

en.title: Sunvozertinib dose and dosing-frequency comparisons
en.summary: Observed aggregate PK supports a dose-exposure fit. A reconstructed parent PopPK model compares paired regimens in4096 conditional virtual patients. Clinical cohort differences, absorption assumptions and limits of split-dose predictions are explicit.
en.seo_title: Sunvozertinib dose and fractionation: exposure limits
en.seo_description: Aggregate PK estimates and conditional PopPK simulations compare sunvozertinib doses and intervals without inferring BID efficacy or diarrhea reduction.
